# Announcement

## Free Google Career Certificates for CPP Students

- CPP students can earn a **Google Career Certificate at no cost** through the **College of Professional and Global Education (CPGE)**
- Details were sent by email; you need to **sign up** to get access
- Gives access to many career certificates and specializations, many related to our careers

::: {.panel-tabset}
## Data Analytics
**Google Data Analytics**: foundational data skills for analyst roles.

## Advanced Data Analytics
**Google Advanced Data Analytics**: builds on the data analytics certificate with more advanced methods.

## Digital Marketing & E-commerce
**Google Digital Marketing & E-commerce**: directly relevant to a digital marketing career.
:::

## Updated Project Template

- Reminder of the announcement from last night: the **project template was revised**
- **From now on, use the new template for all assignments**
- The update emphasizes having **clear POs**, and the template now **expands on and explains what a PO is**

<span class="key-term">PO</span>
: Project Objective

<span class="key-term">AO</span>
: Analytical Objective

::: {.callout-important}
## Rule: Keep Each PO Right Above Its AOs
Always place each PO **directly above** its related AO(s), for example PO1 followed by AO1, then PO2 followed by AO2.

**Why:** the reader should not have to scroll up in the HTML to find a PO and then scroll back down to find the matching AO. Keeping them together makes the report easier to follow.
:::

```{mermaid}
%%| fig-cap: "Correct layout: each PO sits right above its AOs"
flowchart TD
  P1[PO1: Project Objective 1] --> A1[AO1: Analytical Objective]
  P2[PO2: Project Objective 2] --> A2[AO2: Analytical Objective]
  P3[PO3: Project Objective 3] --> A3[AO3: Analytical Objective]
  style P1 fill:#f48fb1,stroke:#c2185b,color:#fff
  style P2 fill:#f48fb1,stroke:#c2185b,color:#fff
  style P3 fill:#f48fb1,stroke:#c2185b,color:#fff
  style A1 fill:#fce4ec,stroke:#ec407a
  style A2 fill:#fce4ec,stroke:#ec407a
  style A3 fill:#fce4ec,stroke:#ec407a
```
